def rarest_color_cells(grid, skip=(0,)):
    """Cells (r,c) of the least frequent non-background color, plus that color."""
    from collections import Counter

    return {(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color}, color

def fit_offsets(grid, cells, target=0):
    """All (dr,dc) offsets translating cells fully onto target-colored cells inside the grid."""
